SharedFlowBundle.name: ISAM-JWT-Token
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Type 6: JWT request, JWT-is-the-token response. No SAML assertion anywhere in this flow: the JWT ISAM returns in the JSON response (assumed field "token"; not a confirmed ISAM contract, see the top-level README) IS the token to use, as-is. Calls only ISAM-Common-CallISAM for the actual ISAM callout -- deliberately does NOT call ISAM-Common-ValidateSignature (XML-DSig doesn't apply to a JWT) or ISAM-Common-CompressAssertion (nothing to compress). The simplest of the six types.
